result.summary: Backports two merged documentation pull requests to the 30.x maintenance branch ahead of a future point release. Specifically, it brings in PR #36377 to document BIP 461 in `bips.md`, and PR #36441 to correct upgrade instructions for installations using the wrapper executable, alongside 30.x release note updates.
result.problem: The 30.x branch lacks documentation updates from master: BIP 461 was omitted from `doc/bips.md`, and the "How to Upgrade" guidance in release notes told users to copy only `bitcoind` or `bitcoin-qt`, which leaves binaries in `libexec/` stale on installs using the `bitcoin` wrapper.
evidence: Commit c09191a0fd and issue #36431: 'Since #31375, Linux installs ship a bitcoin wrapper in bin/ that dispatches to multiprocess binaries in libexec/. Copying only bitcoind/bitcoin-qt leaves those stale. Tell users to copy over bin/ and libexec/ instead.'
Commit 528ee56171 references merged PR #36377 adding BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to bips.md.
result.scope_notes: Backport PR consisting of clean cherry-picks onto the 30.x maintenance branch.
result.changed_since_previous: Added the backport of PR #36441 (fixing issue #36431) to update the "How to Upgrade" section regarding the `bitcoin` wrapper executable and `libexec/` directory.
result.card: Backports documentation fixes to the 30.x maintenance branch for an upcoming point release. It adds BIP 461 to bips.md (PR #36377) and fixes the release notes' "How to Upgrade" section (PR #36441, fixing #36431) so Linux users upgrading installations with the bitcoin wrapper binary know to copy both bin/ and libexec/ to avoid stale multiprocess binaries. Changes are restricted to documentation and release notes.

risk.why: The PR only updates markdown documentation and release notes on a maintenance branch.
